description: Defines an abstract Angular directive class 'DynamicComponent' for rendering dynamic UI components, including methods for sending actions, resolving primitive values, and generating unique IDs.

classes.name: DynamicComponent
classes.description: An abstract Angular directive class for dynamic UI component rendering, handling actions, context, and primitive value resolution.

methods.name: sendAction
methods.description: Sends a user action message to the server, constructing the message with context data.

methods.name: resolvePrimitive
methods.description: Resolves a primitive value (string, boolean, number) from various input types, possibly fetching data via processor.

methods.name: getUniqueId
methods.description: Generates a unique ID string with a given prefix.
